top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a compact prediction-then-discovery chain: the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction at a magic twist angle and the 2018 Jarillo-Herrero group discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, which opened a gate-tunable platform now reproduced by many independent groups. The three-name allocation maps onto the decisive theory and experiment, and the citation, which names the Jarillo-Herrero group, handles the Cao and parallel-group credit gap as well as a three-name limit allows. The open pairing mechanism and eight-year age are real maturity costs but do not call the observed phases into doubt. P001 is a strong, mature, cleanly attributed second choice, but I judge it the smaller scientific step and closer to the lines honoured in 2005 and 2012; either award is preferable to no award.
